svg.title: Lounge PID 3610 — back measurement guide
svg.desc: Orthographic back elevation. Level back and narrow arms, with an inset projecting front apron. L1 Upper back width · L2 Lower back width · J1 Back height (excluding legs). PID-informed construction study. No production measurements assigned. Cushions removed.
svg.metadata: {"example":"extended-center-apron-03","view":"back","source":{"kind":"manufacturer","reference":"https://comfort-works.com/products/lounge-73-apartment-sofa-slipcover","notes":["Visual construction study, not a verified cutting pattern or production measurement guide.","Shape checked against PID 3610 / CB-LE-73__SV_PTD__2S-2B / Original VELC_SP / frame image 13497.","PID frame diagram: back and arm tops form one level rim; narrow arms flank the projecting center panel.","Overall dimensions come from the selected catalogue configuration. Cover dimensions inform proportions, not a verified furniture mesh; leg clearance and back thickness remain estimates.","Center apron extends between the arms. Arm faces continue to the lower body edge independently.","Haven has related projecting construction but a different upholstered junction; this is not an exact Haven template."]},"dimensionsVerified":false,"geometry":{"armFront":75.94,"panelFront":91.44,"panelLeft":10,"panelRight":175.42,"deckHeight":29.5,"legHeight":5,"backTopElevation":63.5,"armTopElevation":63.5},"measurements":[{"label":"L1","meaning":"Overall back width at the top upholstery edge.","start":[0,0,63.5],"end":[185.42,0,63.5]},{"label":"L2","meaning":"Overall back width at the lower upholstery hem.","start":[0,0,5],"end":[185.42,0,5]},{"label":"J1","meaning":"Back height from top edge to lower upholstery hem; excludes legs.","start":[92.71,0,63.5],"end":[92.71,0,5]}],"notApplicable":[]}
